title: ClueCon 2023
html:
ClueCon 2023, the annual RTC conference organized by the FreeSwitch project developers, takes place again in Chicago, during August 14-17, 2023.

Daniel-Constantin Mierla and Fred Posner from the Kamailio community are at the event, both having presentation on the 15th of August.

For more details about the schedule and event, visit their website at:

  • https://www.cluecon.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
